title: Understanding Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption: Practices, Challenges, and Evolution in Open-Source Software
title_zh: 理解后量子密码学的采纳：开源软件中的实践、挑战与演进

paragraphs.en: 研究通过分析179个开源仓库的提交和议题发现，后量子密码学采纳以维护工作为主，构建与依赖问题占挑战一半。 Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards establish algorithms for quantum-safe systems, but empirical evidence about how software projects implement and maintain PQC support remains limited. We investigate this implementation and maintenance work by mining 114,361 commits and 5,713 issues across 179 open-source repositories. We use human annotation and validated LLM classification to identify PQC algorithms in commits, classify their adoption status and deployment mode, and identify technical challenges in issue discussions. The commit classification for PQC algorithms reveals that 90% of commits concern maintenance of existing support. From the issue discussions, we construct an 11-category taxonomy of recurring technical challenges. Build, packaging, and dependency failures, along with functional defects, account for approximately half of categorized issues. To examine how PQC support evolves, we use time-series analysis and first implementations of individual algorithms within repositories around NIST standardization milestones. After the 2024 finalization, standardized algorithm names appeared in more than 80% of the PQC development changes analyzed, although earlier names such as Kyber continued to appear. Development activity increased over the observation period. Our milestone analysis, however, did not find a significant increase in first implementations. Migration plans should therefore account for sustained maintenance, prioritize build reliability and integration testing, and track both standardized and predecessor algorithm names. We make the dataset, taxonomy, annotations, and analysis pipeline publicly available.
paragraphs.zh: 研究通过分析179个开源仓库的提交和议题发现，后量子密码学采纳以维护工作为主，构建与依赖问题占挑战一半。后量子密码学（PQC）标准为量子安全系统确立了算法，但关于软件项目如何实施和维护PQC支持的实证证据仍然有限。 我们通过挖掘179个开源仓库中的114,361个提交和5,713个议题，来研究这种实施和维护工作。 我们使用人工标注和经过验证的LLM分类，在提交中识别PQC算法，对它们的采纳状态和部署模式进行分类，并在议题讨论中识别技术挑战。 针对PQC算法的提交分类显示，90%的提交涉及对现有支持的维护。 从议题讨论中，我们构建了一个包含11个类别的常见技术挑战分类体系。 构建、打包和依赖失败，连同功能缺陷，约占已分类议题的一半。 为了考察PQC支持如何演变，我们使用时间序列分析，并围绕NIST标准化里程碑研究各算法在仓库中的首次实现。 在2024年最终定稿之后，标准化算法名称出现在所分析的80%以上的PQC开发变更中，尽管诸如Kyber等早期名称仍继续出现。 在观察期内，开发活动有所增加。 然而，我们的里程碑分析并未发现首次实现有显著增加。 因此，迁移计划应考虑持续的维护工作，优先保障构建可靠性和集成测试，并同时跟踪标准化算法名称和前身算法名称。 我们公开提供数据集、分类体系、标注和分析流水线。
